versions.content: I/O Hardware Abstraction interfaces MCAL drivers The I/O Hardware Abstraction interfaces on one side the MCAL drivers via Standardized Interfaces and on the other side the Sensor Actuator Software Component via AUTOSAR Interfaces . On the VFB [3] the I/O Hardware Ab- straction is represented by the EcuAbstractionSwComponentType .
